values.note: A fire permit is C$17.00 a day extra.

fees.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/visit/tarifs-fees ('Mosquito Creek - Primitive $22.00'; 'Lake Louise Area Campgrounds and Banff Icefields Parkway Campgrounds - Fire Permit, per day $17.00'; page dated 2026-02-12), read 2026-11-10

values.note: Self-registration: exact change or a credit card, no debit. Six people per site; one RV, one tent and one car. Check-out by 11 am.

booking.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping ('Mosquito Creek Campground offers non-reservable first-come, first-served sites only'; 'Maximum stay - 14 nights'; 'For self-registration campsites, please have exact change or a credit card'; 'Maximum 2 tents and 2 cars; or 1 RV/camper, 1 tent, and 1 car permitted per site'), read 2026-11-10

sites.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping ('Mosquito Creek 38'; 'best suited for tents, or motorhomes and trailers up to 10 meters (35 feet)'), read 2026-11-10. 10 m is 32.8 ft; the lower reading is kept.

values.note: Nearest sani-dump is at Lake Louise campground. No cell coverage.

facilities.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping (Mosquito Creek services: 'Drinking water, Outhouse, Cooking shelter, Picnic shelter, Firepits, Food storage locker'; 'RV campers may use the sani-dump located at Lake Louise campground'; 'There is no cell phone coverage at any campgrounds on the Icefields Parkway'; 'Solar treated potable water and greywater sinks are available'), read 2026-11-10

season.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping (2026 table: Mosquito Creek 'First come first served', operational dates June 11 to October 12; 'Any operational dates before or after the reservable dates are weather dependent and subject to change'), read 2026-11-10

note: On the Icefields Parkway 27 km north of the Highway 1 junction, beside Mosquito Creek and next to the hostel. A wooded loop plus an open gravel area along the creek. Cooking and picnic shelters, food lockers. All vehicles must fit on the site's driveway. --Claude
